commands.graph: Show, enable, disable, or run one Graph turn
commands.mcp: Show client-owned MCP servers and tool publication status
commands.move: Move current session to another directory
commands.recap: One-sentence recap of the session so far
commands.resume: Resume latest interrupted run at a safe boundary
commands.setup: Set up a model provider (API key)
commands.swarm: Show, enable, disable, or run one Swarm turn
commands.transcript: Browse the full transcript inside Maka

keybindings: Ctrl+O — expand or collapse all tool output
Ctrl+T — expand or collapse all thinking in view
Scroll the transcript with your terminal or trackpad
Enter (during a turn) — steer: inject a message into the running turn
Alt+Enter (during a turn) — queue a message for the next turn
Alt+↑ — take queued messages back into the editor to re-edit
Esc Esc (during a turn) — interrupt the turn
Esc Esc (when idle) — rewind to an earlier turn
Ctrl+C — stop the turn, clear input, or press twice to exit
Ctrl+D — exit when input is empty
